title: Administrator login bypass
impact: Allows an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication and obtain an administrator session.
remediation: Use parameterized queries and never build SQL from login input; validate and rate-limit authentication attempts.

title: Product search data extraction
impact: Allows the attacker to manipulate the search query and retrieve unintended or sensitive database data.
remediation: Use parameterized SQL queries and a constrained search API; return only the fields required for product results.

title: Reflected DOM XSS
impact: Arbitrary JavaScript executes in the victim's browser and can be used to steal session data or perform actions as the victim.
remediation: Encode untrusted search input for HTML context and use a strict output-encoding policy or sanitization library.

title: Persistent iframe XSS
impact: A malicious iframe executes whenever a user loads the affected page, enabling persistent phishing or account actions.
remediation: Sanitize stored HTML before saving and rendering, prohibit executable iframe sources and unsafe attributes, and apply a restrictive Content Security Policy.
